name: CharXiv
description: CharXiv is a comprehensive evaluation suite designed to measure chart understanding capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) using 2,323 natural, challenging, and diverse charts from arXiv papers. It includes descriptive questions about basic chart elements and reasoning questions requiring synthesis across complex visual elements, aiming to provide a realistic and faithful measure of progress in chart understanding.
reputation: A recent and increasingly cited multimodal benchmark for chart understanding, valued for its realistic arXiv-chart distribution and challenging reasoning questions.
notes: Charts and questions are handpicked, curated, and verified by human experts; highlights a large gap between proprietary and open-source models and human performance.
